passages.text: Asplenium sect. Thamnopteris C.Presl, commonly called bird-nest fern, is a morphologically distinct group with distribution in the tropics and subtropics of the Old World. The distinguishing features of this section are in fronds simple, entire, and set in a close spiral, and veins parallel, close, with their tips united and forming an intramarginal vein (Holttum 1974).
